title: 終極密碼(1~100)
question:
老師先隨機挑選一個1~100的數字讓5位學生來猜，猜到就贏了！
猜到時恭喜該位學生！沒猜到的話恭喜老師！

test_case.note: 密碼設定為25，學生依序猜測2、95、5、20、26。沒人猜到，恭喜老師
密碼設定為50，學生依序猜測30、70、50，由3號學生猜到

en.title: Guess the Number (1~100)
en.question:
The teacher picks a number from 1~100. 5 students guess. If a student gets it, the student wins!
If nobody gets it, the teacher wins!

test_case.note: The number is 25. Students guess 2, 95, 5, 20, 26. Nobody gets it. Teacher wins
The number is 50. Students guess 30, 70, 50. Student 3 gets it
